6.405 rsInvalidScopeCollectionReference
Applies to RDL 2012/01
rsInvalidScopeCollectionReference is a critical error that occurs when there is an expression with a
reference to the Global.Scopes collection in which it is not allowed. The Global.Scopes collection
cannot be used outside a DataRegion. The Global.Scopes collection cannot be used in an aggregate
parameter expression.
